svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 03: The crew desk
svg.text: Crew land on today’s run of show: the day down the page, a now line, live controls on each item, and what needs them above it.
Use case: a Food crew member runs the evening from one page, on the laptop at the food table or on a phone on the floor (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Pizza order 2 is not called in yet
Held by Sami · closes 18:30, in 18 min
Delivery for order 1 is 10 min late
Ask the pizzeria, or tell the people waiting
Delays move the later items too; attendees see the new times
Main hall · Round 3 of 4 · the session’s own controls are for Tournament crew
Food table · 2 orders open · ordering closes at 18:30
Main stage · Fires a Prize draw moment on the screens

svg.text: A · 1280 px: needs you as a band above the day; every item carries the controls its kind allows

g.text: Pizza order 2 is not called in
Fires a Prize draw moment on the screens

svg.text: B · 390 px: the same day, one column

g.text: Fires a Prize draw moment on the screens
A notice to everyone who follows the raffle

svg.text: C · 390 px: a delay is chips, never a typed number
Notes: crew see every item of today but act only on their own parts (U2); the session’s own controls stay with Tournament crew.
Food’s order times and the raffle are run-of-show items, as the run of show is the event’s one schedule (L2).
